operation_guides.Bearing pickup: Watch the gripper move between the supply area and fixture. Check whether a bearing is visibly retained; these overview pictures alone do not confirm a successful pickup.
operation_guides.Bearing pressing: Watch the tool approach and withdraw from the fixture. Actual bearing seating and pressing force cannot be confirmed from these spaced overview pictures.
operation_guides.Component handling: Watch the robot move towards the circular fixture and compare its withdrawal. A component may be hidden by the arm; a drop cannot be confirmed from the filename alone.
operation_guides.Screwing: Watch the fastening tool approach and remain near the circular assembly. The images show tool position, not measured rotation, thread engagement or tightening torque.

clip_overviews.prefilter_good_bearingpick.mp4: The early samples show the robot near the supply area; later samples show its tool near the right-hand fixture before moving away.
clip_overviews.prefilter_bad_bearingpick.mp4: The robot position changes early, then looks similar across several later samples. Check the original clip to determine whether pickup failed or motion stopped.
clip_overviews.prefilter_good_bearingpress_1.mp4: The robot moves from the supply side towards the right-hand fixture and then away. The bearing itself is small in this wide view.
clip_overviews.prefilter_bad_bearingpress_1.mp4: The robot approaches the right-hand workstation and appears in a similar pose across much of the later sampled sequence. This does not establish the cause of a press failure.
clip_overviews.tubeinterface_good_dropped_1.mp4: The arm approaches the front circular work area, changes pose near it, and withdraws in the final samples.
clip_overviews.tubeinterface_bad_dropped_1.mp4: The arm approaches the front circular work area and remains in a similar pose in the later samples. The arm obscures part of the handling area.
clip_overviews.tubeinterface_good_screwing.mp4: The tool approaches the circular assembly, remains near it for several samples, and withdraws near the end.
clip_overviews.tubeinterface_bad_screwing.mp4: The tool approaches the circular assembly and stays near it across several samples before withdrawing. Actual fastening success requires additional evidence.
